hooks.command: if ! command -v lait >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'lait plugin: the `lait` binary is not on your PATH, so its MCP server cannot start. Install it from the latest release (the lait-installer.sh asset at https://github.com/Nixie-Tech-LLC/lait/releases/latest).'; elif ! ctx=$(lait context 2>&1); then echo "lait plugin: $ctx"; else store=$(printf '%s\n' "$ctx" | sed -n 's/^path  *//p' | tr '\\' '/'); if [ -z "$store" ]; then echo 'lait plugin: no lait space is visible from this directory, so the MCP tools have nothing to bind to. Open a directory inside a space, or found one with `lait init`.'; elif [ -n "${LAIT_AGENT:-}" ] && [ ! -f "$store/agents/${LAIT_AGENT}/secret.key" ]; then echo "lait plugin: no local agent identity '${LAIT_AGENT}' on this node. The MCP tools will refuse rather than quietly sign the agent's work as you. Provision it once with: lait members agent --new ${LAIT_AGENT}"; fi; fi
